t: Wakeup briefing age-marks items open 2+ sessions and prompts on 3+
gb: PathFinder Historian first pass (2026-03-25) via incoming signal
challenge: Open items that survive multiple sessions without resolution are listed flat alongside new items in the wakeup briefing. A 3-session-old item looks identical to a new one, normalizing stale work and hiding decisions that were never made.
hypothesis: Active Work section in wakeup Step 7 marks items by session age: [2s] for 2 sessions open, [3s+] for three or more. Items open 3+ sessions show a prompt: 'Open 3 sessions — still relevant? (keep / close / defer)'. Age computed from lug created_at vs current session count.
next_step: update wai.md Step 7 (Display Briefing) Active Work format to include age markers
